    messageboard 1.0-SNAPSHOT API

    Packages
    Package
    Description
    jwium.lab1.messageboard
    Main package containing the application entry point for the Messageboard project.
    jwium.lab1.messageboard.controller
    Contains controller classes responsible for managing the application flow, coordinating user inputs, handling business logic execution, and orchestrating views.
    jwium.lab1.messageboard.exception
    Contains custom exception classes used across the message board application to handle error states and invalid operations, such as incorrect message indices.
    jwium.lab1.messageboard.model
    Contains data models and business logic managers representing the core entities (such as individual messages and collections) of the message board application.
    jwium.lab1.messageboard.view
    Contains view and presentation classes responsible for handling console input streams from the user and displaying formatted outputs, menus, and messages.
